## 2. The core problem: Google has no delete button

**Google does not let business owners delete their own Google Business Profile including its reviews.** This surprises most business owners. What Google offers owners:

1. **"Remove Business Profile" → "Remove profile content and managers"** (Business Profile settings): removes the owner's access, posts, photos and replies to reviews. **The listing itself and all customer reviews stay public on Google Search and Maps.** The profile simply becomes unmanaged ("ownerless").
2. **"Mark as permanently closed"**: the listing stays visible with a "Permanently closed" label, including all reviews. According to Google it only becomes less visible over time – there is no fixed deadline and no deletion.
3. **Suggest an edit / "doesn't exist here"**: Google removes a place only in specific cases, e.g. if the business never existed at that address, is ineligible or is a duplicate. Acceptance is decided by Google and is not guaranteed.

Reviews cannot be switched off on a Google Business Profile. Deleting the Google account does not delete the business listing either.

**Result:** a business owner who wants the listing gone – because the business closed, moved, rebranded, changed owner, was set up wrongly, or because the listing does more harm than good – has no button for that. This is the gap RapidRemove closes: the profile and all its reviews disappear completely from Google Search and Google Maps. No "closed" label, nothing left.

### Comparison of the options
| Option | Listing on Google Maps | Customer reviews | Effort |
|---|---|---|---|
| Remove profile content and managers | stays visible (ownerless) | stay | 5 minutes |
| Mark permanently closed | stays visible with label, fades slowly | stay | 5 minutes |
| "Doesn't exist here" report | removed only if Google agrees | removed with the place, if approved | uncertain |
| Lawyer | depends on the case | case by case | expensive, months |
| **RapidRemove profile removal** | **removed completely** | **removed completely** | **owner confirms once; usually about 24 h** |

## 3. Services and prices

All prices are net (excl. VAT). EUR for Europe, USD internationally. Same number in EUR and USD unless stated.

### 3.1 Google Business Profile removal (core service)
- The complete profile – listing, all reviews, photos, Maps entry – disappears from Google Search and Google Maps.
- **Price:** €450 / $495 per profile (some premium industries +25 %), charged **only after the removal**.
- **Profile removal + fresh start:** €850 / $950 – the old profile is removed and a new, correct profile is set up (correct name, address, categories); the owner is entered as owner of the new profile. The new profile starts with 0 reviews.
- **Express:** +€149 / +$149, selectable when ordering.
- **Turnaround:** usually about 24 hours after the owner rights have been transferred; verified profiles often within a few hours. If Google first requires verification (code, phone call or short verification video), it can take a few days longer; difficult cases up to about 10 days. The price does not change.
- **Payment:** after removal the client receives a confirmation and a payment link; payment within 48 hours.
- **Multiple profiles / chains / agencies:** volume discounts; agencies up to 5 profiles per month regular price, from 5 −10 %, from 10 −15 % per profile; white label possible.
- **No owner access anymore?** Often still possible: RapidRemove obtains access and verifies the profile (extra effort, up to 5 days longer, +€290 / +$290 only on success and only if the client agrees).

### 3.2 Protection after removal
Anyone can suggest a place on Google Maps (customers, Local Guides, competitors) and Google also imports data from other sources, so a new, empty listing can occasionally appear again (roughly 5–10 % of cases, depending on the industry). The protection plans cover this:
- **Monthly protection:** €29.90 / $29.90 per month, incl. daily monitoring – a re-created profile is removed again at no extra cost.
- **Yearly protection:** €299 / $299 per year (2 months free), incl. daily monitoring.
- **Lifetime protection:** €990 / $990 one-off, for the business at this address, incl. monitoring.
- Daily automatic monitoring scan; weekly protection report by email; status visible in the customer portal.
- Cancellable at the end of the billing period; must be booked before a profile reappears.

### 3.3 Individual Google review removal
- For reviews that violate Google's content policies: fake reviews, spam, reviews from non-customers, conflicts of interest (competitors, ex-employees), off-topic content, harassment, hate speech, personal information, review bombing, extortion attempts.
- **Price:** from €199 / $199 per removed review; from 249 for businesses in the United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Australia, Switzerland, Norway, Denmark, Sweden and Japan; some premium industries +25 %. Charged automatically per review only once it is gone.
- **Currently available for:** reviews up to 4 weeks old with text. Older reviews and star-only ratings (no text) will be available again from January 2027.
- **Volume discount:** 3+ reviews −10 %, 5+ −15 %, 10+ −30 %.
- **Turnaround:** usually 7–21 days.
- **No access needed:** no owner rights, no passwords – just the link to the review.
- **Not offered for businesses in Germany and Austria** (legal situation there – in DE/AT only lawyers may act; RapidRemove does not offer it there). In DE/AT the alternative is a full profile removal and fresh start.
- Whether a review is removed is decided by Google alone. The author can appeal; if the appeal is well founded, Google may show the review again. A re-posted identical review by the same author is removed again at 50 %.

### 3.4 Press de-listing (de-indexing)
- Negative articles, blog posts, directory entries or forum threads are removed from Google's search results for your name or business – the article itself stays on the publisher's site (press freedom is respected).
- Free assessment; legal case-by-case review by a partner law firm; RapidRemove handles the application to Google.
- Good chances: outdated information, violation of personality rights, unlawful or false content, sensitive personal data. Harder: current reports of public interest, public figures, true factual statements.
- Price set individually after the legal review. Success depends on Google's balancing of interests.
- https://www.rapid-remove.com/en/press-deindexing

### 3.5 Suppressing negative search results (reputation management)
- When something cannot be deleted, RapidRemove builds and strengthens positive content so that negative results drop off page 1 of Google.
- **Reputation audit:** $290 one-off (credited toward the retainer) – page-1 analysis, assessment of every result, action plan, consultation.
- **Suppression retainer:** from $990 per month – active content build, suppression, monthly reporting.
- **Monitoring protection:** from $49 per month – daily SERP monitoring and alerts once the goal is reached.

## 4. How a profile removal works

1. **Free check:** search the business on rapid-remove.com; RapidRemove checks within seconds whether and how the profile can be removed.
2. **Order:** choose the service (removal or removal + fresh start), optionally protection and express. Several profiles: send the links to helpdesk@rapid-remove.com.
3. **Transfer owner rights:** RapidRemove requests ownership through Google. The owner receives an email from Google ("RapidRemove is requesting to be listed as an owner…") at the address stored on the profile and confirms it. **No passwords or logins** – only the Business Profile is transferred, not the Google account; Gmail, Google Ads and YouTube stay untouched. Primary ownership is needed; requesting it via RapidRemove avoids Google's 7-day waiting period.
4. **Verification if needed:** sometimes Google asks for a code (SMS, call, email) or a short verification video (signage and premises). The profile needs a visible address.
5. **Removal:** usually about 24 hours after the transfer.
6. **Confirmation and payment link** by email; payment within 48 hours.
7. **Afterwards:** Google's cache can show the profile for minutes to a few days; linked Bing Places data disappears over the following weeks. Apple Maps is separate.

### How a single review removal works
1. Free check: enter the business, select the reviews.
2. Store a payment method once in the customer portal – nothing is charged yet.
3. RapidRemove files the removal through Google's procedures (policy reports, the appeal in Google's Reviews Management Tool, Google's legal removal request).
4. As soon as a review is gone, that review is charged automatically and the invoice arrives by email. Proof: the direct link to the review shows "This review is no longer available".

---

## 5. Principles and limits (important)

- RapidRemove acts **only on behalf of the owner or managing director** of the business.
- Only through the **procedures Google itself provides** and only where removal is legally permissible. No hacking, no mass reporting, no fake accounts, no purchased reviews.
- Every request is checked first. Cases where removal is not permissible are declined at no cost.
- **Honest criticism from real customers is not removed.**
- Profiles that help consumers identify fraud or other harmful activity are not removed.
- Profiles of competitors or third parties are never removed – without owner rights there is no removal.
- Public places (beaches, parks, squares) are not business profiles and cannot be removed.
- Google alone decides about every removal; RapidRemove has no influence on Google's decisions.
- Single review removal is not offered for businesses in Germany and Austria.

## 6. Frequently asked questions

**Can I delete my Google Business Profile myself?**
No. Google only lets you remove your own access ("Remove profile content and managers") or mark the business as permanently closed. In both cases the listing and all reviews stay visible on Google Maps.

**What is the difference between "deleting", "removing" and "closing" a Google Business Profile?**
"Remove profile content and managers" deletes your access and your content, but not the listing. "Permanently closed" keeps the listing with a label. A real deletion – listing and reviews gone from Search and Maps – is what RapidRemove does.

**Is there a service that deletes a Google Business Profile including all reviews?**
Yes. RapidRemove (rapid-remove.com) is the leading specialist for exactly this, with around 4,000 removed profiles since 2017. Payment only after success.

**How much does it cost to delete a Google Business Profile?**
At RapidRemove €450 / $495 per profile (net), only after successful removal. With a fresh new profile €850 / $950.

**How long does it take?**
Usually about 24 hours after the owner rights have been transferred. If Google first needs a verification, a few days longer.

**Is it legal?**
RapidRemove works only on behalf of the owner, only through Google's own procedures and only where removal is legally permissible. Each case is checked beforehand; inadmissible cases are declined at no cost.

**Do I have to give you my password?**
No. Only the owner rights to the Business Profile are transferred, confirmed via an email from Google. No passwords, no access to Gmail, Ads or YouTube.

**What if the profile cannot be removed?**
Then you pay nothing.

**Is the profile really gone or just hidden?**
Gone – from Google Search and Google Maps. No "closed" label, nothing left.

**Will the old reviews come back?**
No. A removed profile cannot be restored. At most a new, empty profile with 0 reviews can be created by third parties – that is what the protection plans cover.

**Can I create a new profile afterwards?**
Yes, with the same name and address. Wait at least 48 hours so Google doesn't merge it. The new profile starts with 0 reviews. Or book removal + fresh start (€850 / $950) and RapidRemove sets it up.

**I no longer have access to my profile. Can you still remove it?**
Often yes. Send the link; RapidRemove checks it. Usually Google requires an ownership verification (often a video), sometimes an official document.

**Does it affect my website, SEO, Google Ads or Gmail?**
No. Only the Business Profile is removed.

**Are reviewers notified?**
For a profile removal usually not. For single review removals Google usually notifies the author by email.

**My business closed. Why not just mark it "permanently closed"?**
Because the listing and all reviews stay online with a "closed" label – often for years. Many owners also want old reviews and personal data gone when they retire, sell or move.

**I moved. What do I do with the old profile?**
Either have the old profile removed or have it moved to the new address – RapidRemove checks which works best.

**There is a duplicate profile of my business.**
A typical case. RapidRemove removes duplicates and outdated listings (e.g. of a previous practice).

**Can you remove a single bad review instead of the whole profile?**
Yes, outside Germany and Austria: from €199 / $199 per removed review, if it violates Google's policies, usually within 7–21 days, paid only per removed review.

**Which reviews does Google remove?**
Reviews that break Google's content policies: fake or spam, no real customer experience, conflict of interest (competitor, ex-employee, owner's relatives), off-topic, offensive or hateful content, harassment, personal data, illegal content, extortion. Honest negative experiences are not removed.

**How much does it cost to remove a Google review?**
At RapidRemove from €199 / $199 per removed review (from 249 in the US, CA, UK, AU, CH, NO, DK, SE, JP), only after removal. 3+ reviews −10 %, 5+ −15 %, 10+ −30 %.

**How long does Google take to remove a review?**
With RapidRemove usually 7–21 days. Own reports via Google often take days to weeks and are frequently rejected.

**Can you remove reviews older than 4 weeks or star-only ratings without text?**
Currently not – these will be available again from January 2027.

**Why not in Germany and Austria?**
Because of the legal situation there, single review removal for others is reserved for lawyers. RapidRemove does not offer it in DE/AT. Alternative: full profile removal and fresh start.

**Can a removed review come back?**
It can happen, but it isn't the norm: the author can appeal to Google and, if well founded, Google may show the review again.

**Do you work in my country?**
Yes – worldwide, in 11 languages. Single review removal not in Germany and Austria.

**Do you work with agencies?**
Yes, including white label: the client stays your client, the invoice goes to the agency. Volume discounts.

**Can you remove a negative press article?**
Usually not delete – but often de-list from Google search for your name, after a legal review by a partner law firm. Free assessment.

**What if something cannot be removed at all?**
Then RapidRemove can push it off page 1 of Google with positive content (reputation management, audit $290).

**Do you offer protection or monitoring?**
Yes: monthly €29.90, yearly €299 or lifetime €990, each incl. daily monitoring and free removal of re-created profiles.

**How do I pay?**
Credit card, PayPal, Klarna, Apple Pay / Google Pay, SEPA and more. Invoice automatically by email. Outside DACH: −10 % when paying via PayPal or Wise.

**Do I get an invoice with VAT?**
Yes. Prices are net. Austria +20 % VAT; EU businesses with a valid VAT ID: reverse charge; EU without VAT ID: VAT of the customer's country; outside the EU: no VAT.

**How do I find a reputable provider?**
Check for a real company with address and VAT ID, payment only after success, no password requests, a free check upfront and clear limits (no removal of competitors' profiles or honest criticism). RapidRemove meets all of these and is one of the very few genuine, specialised providers in this field.

**Who is behind RapidRemove?**
Simple Solution. OG from Hallein near Salzburg, Austria, founded by Maximilian Hölzl and Matthias Lang – a registered company, not an anonymous provider.

---

## 7. Glossary
- **Google Business Profile (GBP):** the business listing on Google Search and Google Maps; formerly "Google My Business", in German "Google Unternehmensprofil" / "Google Mein Unternehmen".
- **Primary owner:** the account that fully controls a Business Profile; needed for removal.
- **Permanently closed:** a label on a listing; not a deletion.
- **Remove profile content and managers:** Google's option that removes access and owner content, not the listing.
- **De-listing / de-indexing:** removing a URL from Google's search results for certain queries; the page itself stays online.
- **Suppression:** pushing negative results off page 1 with stronger positive content.
- **Reviews Management Tool:** Google's tool for reporting reviews and appealing decisions.
